about.description: A modern iperf3 alternative with a live TUI, multi-client server, and QUIC support. Built in Rust.
about.head: 3ae782b

name: v0.11.0
body:
## What's Changed
* test(quic): cover multi-stream bitrate pacing by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/203
* build(deps): update rustls to 0.23.45 (RUSTSEC-2026-0285) by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/206
* build(deps): bump taiki-e/install-action from 2.87.4 to 2.87.10 in the github-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/205
* build(deps): bump the rust-dependencies group across 1 directory with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/207
* build(deps): bump the github-actions group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/209
* fix: support configurable UDP payload sizes for lower-MTU paths by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/214
* fix: keep JSON summary and stream output parseable by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/215
* fix: reject invalid report intervals before starting a test by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/216
* fix: reject invalid diff thresholds that hide regressions by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/217
* fix: keep graph loss visible when throughput drops to zero by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/218
* Bound QUIC cancellation when control writes stall by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/219
* fix: validate and honor server rate-limit windows by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/220
* fix: honor timestamp formats in TUI history by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/222
* fix: honor explicit server ports equal to the default by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/223
* Cancel legacy UDP setup without waiting for a hello by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/224
* fix: refresh transport options after TUI settings changes by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/225
* fix: validate effective address-family settings by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/226
* fix: keep settings usable in compact terminals by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/227
* Keep client cancellation responsive and clean up dropped runs by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/228
* fix: validate client defaults and duration limits by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/229
* fix: resolve and save theme preferences consistently by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/230
* Bound idle QUIC control-stream setup waits by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/231
* docs: refresh shipped features and remaining network limits by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/232
* Cancel QUIC downloads blocked on stream credit by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/221
* build(deps): bump the rust-dependencies group across 1 directory with 10 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/212
* fix(tui): resolve zero-copy per run after a settings protocol switch by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/233
* feat(tui): report test status to the terminal via OSC 7501 by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/234
* refactor(tui): remove the unused ProgressBar widget by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/235
* fix(udp): report UDP send errors to the client by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/237
* test(client): wait for the progress queue to fill instead of a fixed sleep by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/240
* fix(net): honor IPv6 zone IDs for link-local hosts by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/239
* fix(server): keep stalled control writes from freezing tests by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/236
* feat(udp): separate bidirectional receiver stats and stream rates by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/238
* fix(serve): send UDP from the address the client targeted by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/242
* fix(udp): correct loss under reordering and duplication by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/241
* fix(udp): ignore a lone far-future sequence and keep UDP counters behind the lock by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/243
* chore: release prep for 0.11.0 by @lance0 in https://github.com/lance0/xfr/pull/244


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lance0/xfr/compare/v0.10.1...v0.11.0
